strings.en:
{0c:51502b581000}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
I do not say it is wrong for humanity to

Is that all you have to say, you enemies of God!
As promised, I will let you fight God. Come, then, to the 'Land of Origin'.
Madness! The light has not yet gone out. They must not be allowed to go!
Of course I have not given up on the coming of the 'New World'. // But I find I wish to test it: this truth they speak of. // [1]Besides, that one has earned the right.

{0c:2b502351202b5f1000}淋しさは変わらなかった。{1a}{0c:52ffffc2ffffca}{e0e5}りにいる人は、
